name: ov2640
title: OmniVision OV2640
notes: A 2-megapixel sensor with its own compression: 15 frames a second at 1600x1200, 30 at 800x600. XVCLK 6 to 24 MHz. It takes 1.2 V for its core, 2.5 to 3.0 V for its analog part and 1.7 to 3.3 V for its port.

facts.source: OV2640_DS(1.6), the datasheet in Datasheet/OV2640 of github.com/Freenove/Freenove_ESP32_WROVER_Board

id.by: a probe with esp32-camera 2.1.8 on the ESP32-WROVER-DEV
id.notes: PID 0x26, VER 0x42, maker 0x7fa2 at SCCB 0x30; an 800x600 JPEG.
